tools.name: render_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to preview or generate a chart. Validate each generated or changed chart input once before rendering, saving, or updating. Do not revalidate unchanged input; a successful render preflights it for later saves or updates. Errors block; warnings require explicit user approv

tools.name: save_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to permanently save and publish a Szum chart document. Validate each generated or changed chart input once before rendering, saving, or updating. Do not revalidate unchanged input; a successful render preflights it for later saves or updates. Errors block; warnings requi

tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find charts in their saved library. Returns paginated metadata and URLs, not chart documents; requires authentication. Draft-only editor charts have publishedAt null, hasDraft true, and sizeBytes 0 because sizeBytes measures only the stored published document, not dra

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and wants to view it or retrieve its metadata and URLs. Displays the published chart when available and does not return its document; requires authentication.

tools.name: get_chart_document
tools.description: Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and needs its complete published Szum document for inspection or reuse. Does not return a newer editor draft; requires authentication.

tools.name: get_preview_state
tools.description: Use this when the Szum chart App needs to restore a rendered preview as its current transient or saved view. It is read-only, owner-scoped when authenticated, and hidden from the model.

tools.name: update_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to replace and publish a saved chart's document while keeping its id and URLs. Validate each generated or changed chart input once before rendering, saving, or updating. Do not revalidate unchanged input; a successful render preflights it for later saves or updates. Erro

tools.name: rename_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a saved chart's library title without changing its document, publication state, or public URLs; requires authentication.

tools.name: delete_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to permanently delete one saved chart. Deletion cannot be undone, and retrying an already completed deletion succeeds; requires authentication.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Use this when choosing a visual theme for a chart. Returns every built-in theme with guidance on where each works best and, when signed in, the workspace's shared themes.

tools.name: validate_chart
tools.description: Use this when a chart request or document will be rendered, saved, or updated. Validate each generated or changed chart input once before rendering, saving, or updating. Do not revalidate unchanged input; a successful render preflights it for later saves or updates. Errors block; warnings require ex

tools.name: list_chart_types
tools.description: Use this when choosing a chart family. Returns every current chart type with its shared and family-specific fields.

tools.name: get_examples
tools.description: Get complete Szum documents for validation, rendering, or saving, with guidance on when to use each pattern. No filters returns one starter per chart type. Any filter searches the complete catalog; all supplied filters intersect. Most data is illustrative; the Vinyl waterfall cites RIAA reports. Emp

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Use this before authoring an unfamiliar field instead of probing validate_chart for errors. Returns the JSON Schema for the whole Szum document, covering config, data, presentation, size, and output, with every referenced definition included. Pass chart_type to keep only that family's config variant

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_charts, get_chart, validate_chart · Private data: save_chart, list_charts, get_chart, get_chart_document, update_chart, rename_chart, validate_chart, get_examples, get_schema · Public sink: save_chart, update_chart · Destructive: render_chart, save_chart, update_chart, delete_chart, validate_chart, get_examples.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_charts, get_chart, validate_chart · Private data: save_chart, list_charts, get_chart, get_chart_document, update_chart, rename_chart, validate_chart, get_examples, get_schema · Public sink: save_chart, update_chart · Destructive: render_chart, save_chart, update_chart, delete_chart, validate_chart, get_examples

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "render_chart" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when the user wants to preview or generate a chart from a Szum config after preflighting a generated or materially changed config with validate_chart. Stores a one-hour preview and returns a public image URL; authenticated calls use the account's render allowance." → after: "Use this when the user wants to preview or generate a chart. Validate each generated or changed chart input once before rendering, saving, or updating. Do not revalidate unchanged input; a successful render preflights it for later saves or updates. Errors block; warnings require explicit user approv"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
